components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Garden-green capsule action with a small structural shadow.
components.css: .ds-primary { background: var(--green); color: var(--primary-ink); padding: 13px 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 50px; font: 750 0.9rem 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 3px 2px var(--primary-shadow); transition: transform 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-primary:active { transform: translateY(2px); }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Outlined capsule action on the secondary theme surface.
components.css: .ds-secondary { background: var(--secondary-bg); color: var(--ink); padding: 13px 22px; border: 1px solid var(--secondary-border); border-radius: 50px; font: 750 0.9rem 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-secondary:active { transform: translateY(2px); }

components.name: Collection Action
components.description: Yellow capsule link with a contrasting inset arrow.
components.css: .ds-collection { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 30px; min-height: 52px; padding: 8px 9px 8px 23px; color: var(--sun-ink); background: var(--sun); border-radius: 50px; font: 700 1rem 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-collection-arrow { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--sun-ink); color: var(--sun); font-size: 1.4rem; } .ds-collection:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Picture Card
components.description: Picture-card shell with a curved art slot; the application supplies its original pixel artwork.
components.css: .ds-picture-card { display: flex; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--card-border); border-radius: 28px 16px 28px 16px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); text-align: left; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-picture-art { width: 180px; min-height: 190px; flex: 0 0 auto; background: var(--picture-bg); border-radius: 0 40% 40% 0 / 0 20% 25% 0; } .ds-picture-copy { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; padding: 22px; } .ds-picture-title { margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-card-action { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: auto; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 800; } .ds-card-arrow { display: grid; place-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; margin-left: 8px; width: 32px; height: 32px; background: var(--land); border-radius: 50%; font-size: 1.2rem; transition: transform 400ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-picture-card:hover { border-color: var(--green); background: var(--tool-bg); } .ds-picture-card:hover .ds-card-arrow, .ds-picture-card:focus-visible .ds-card-arrow { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-picture-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Answer Field
components.description: Large centered field for entering a short numeric answer.
components.css: .ds-answer-wrap { display: inline-grid; } .ds-answer-label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-answer { width: 78px; height: 66px; padding: 3px; border: 2px solid var(--input-border); border-radius: 15px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--green); caret-color: var(--green); text-align: center; font: 800 2rem 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-answer:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Number Key
components.description: Rounded numeric keypad key with a slim border and small lower shadow.
components.css: .ds-key { min-height: 56px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--key-border); border-radius: 20px 16px 20px 16px; background: var(--pill-bg); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 3px 2px var(--key-shadow); font: 750 1.45rem 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-key:hover { background: var(--key-hover); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-key:active { transform: translateY(2px); }

components.name: Game Navigation
components.description: Text back action and level indicator above the active picture.
components.css: .ds-game-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; } .ds-back { padding: 0 8px 0 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 700 0.86rem 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-level { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--pill-bg); color: var(--ink); font: 400 0.73rem 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-game-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Mathixel's interface is a playful park for discovering original pixel pictures through arithmetic. Pale paper grounds the scenes; broad green islands, bright yellow sign-like actions, and small pixel creatures give the experience its park-map character. Trebuchet MS and system sans-serif keep the lettering direct and readable beside the artwork.

The same visual vocabulary appears in the picture collection, the carried picture and answer staging during play, and the completed-picture screen. Flat color fields and asymmetrical rounded forms organize the interface; the original pixel picture remains the focus rather than decorative chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Pale paper, ink, garden greens, and a concentrated yellow action color.
Original pixel artwork presented on softly colored picture grounds.
Capsule actions alongside irregular island and card silhouettes.
A consistent picture-first thread from collection through solving to completion.

rules.name: The Garden-Action Rule
rules.body: Use garden green for primary actions and active states; use bright yellow for the collection action, easiest-difficulty sign, and completion discovery mark.

rules.name: The Ink-Sans Rule
rules.body: Keep interface copy in the shared sans-serif family; let the pixel pictures, not novelty display lettering, carry the playful character.

rules.name: The Picture-Stays-With-the-Task Rule
rules.body: Keep the selected picture alongside the equation during play and repeat that picture as the focus of completion.

dos: Do use the original pixel pictures as the recurring visual subject.
Do use green for primary actions and active progress, and yellow for the collection action, easiest-difficulty sign, and completion discovery mark.
Do keep the picture visible beside the arithmetic task and prominent on completion.
Do preserve the light and dark semantic color mappings when extending the interface.
donts: Don't turn the picture park into a pastel marketing gallery; the implemented world uses bold green islands, ink sans, and yellow actions.
Don't replace the original pixel artwork with external artwork.
Don't apply shadows as a universal surface treatment; the implemented shadows are reserved for controls and modal separation.
